scientific_limitations: Exact only for the regular octahedron in three Euclidean dimensions under Haar-random orthogonal planar projection, with unit coordinate vertices; not a general-body distribution. An arXiv:2609.24131 full-text overlap comparison remains inaccessible.
title: Exact inradius law for random planar projections of the regular octahedron
